book.name: Aposel
book.title: Aposel heki’walaŋ kwanai diniŋ kahat Lukdi youkuk

content: Koniliyasdi Pitadok mede kamemimbune wooŋ kaguk
Sisaliya uŋoŋ me niŋ hatiluguk wou Koniliyas, adi Loma mikme bop wohik Itali Mikme yeniyagiŋ’walaŋ talitimeŋ.
Adi ne tiŋa wapmihiŋiŋ-tam Bepaŋ kunumneniŋ gikiŋgoŋ timiŋa niutumbayagiŋ, eŋ Juda memetam fiyewakahi siloŋ tiyemiluguk, eŋ Bepaŋ helemahelemaŋ ninadiluguk.
Ala heleniŋ 3 kilok tebele Bepaŋdi nadinadiŋiŋ tubutombu nemek lihine foloŋ dabugoŋ indiŋ kaguk: Bepaŋ aŋeloŋiŋdi buŋa indiŋ niŋguk, “Koniliyas”.

Unduŋ nimbune munta tiŋa uŋgoŋ kahohoŋe tiŋa yoguk, “Wapum, maŋgoŋ?” Yobune aŋelodibo niŋguk, “Bepaŋ adi fiyewakahi yehitubu-lodaaŋ momooŋ tiyemilaŋ eŋ Bepaŋ ninadilaŋ wondok nadiune momooŋ tilak doktiŋa medege agaŋ nadilak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa du me neeŋ yeniŋkulune Yopade wooŋ me niŋ wou Saimon Pita kaŋ nagi buneeŋ.
Adi, wou yolineŋ nalum buŋa hatak. Wou adi imeŋgwaŋ gagayeŋ itouŋa kale gitnem kwanai tilak.”
Unduŋ niŋa aŋelo adi kotigoŋ uguk, kaŋ Koniliyas adi tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ lufom eŋ ne’walaŋ mikme bop gineniŋ me Bepaŋ gikiŋgoŋ timiluguk niŋ yenimbu bugiŋ.
Buune nemek mintaguk u yeniŋa yeniŋkulune Yopade ugiŋ.
Heleune Yopa tubudulalu mele lekiŋgoŋ ilune Pita adi Bepaŋ ninadiwe yot ki foloŋ loguk.
Nanaŋe kougoŋ tiulidokolu map nadiune Bepaŋdi nadinadiŋiŋ tubutombu nemek indiŋ kaguk:
kunum dilitombune molom diniŋ saŋiniŋ nemek haule batei dabugoŋ diki lufolufom gineŋ honekilitinit kameu fou kaguk.
Maaneŋ uŋoŋ miŋgembet, kale, bagi mebimebi boigiŋ.
U yabuŋa nadilu mede niŋ indiŋ mintaguk, “Pita, pilali widihiŋa hinaweŋ.”
Mede unduŋ mintaguk kaŋ Pitadi yoguk, “Wapum, koom Mosesdi kamehep tinimguk doktiŋa nu nemek undihi-kabe nemu nakagut.”
Unduŋ yobu kotigoŋ yoguk, “Bepaŋdi nemek kedem yolak kaŋ du maŋgoŋde moŋ yolaŋ?”
Nemek u nai lufomkulitniŋ mintaune kotigoŋ kunum gineŋ hamaneune udaneeŋ loguk.
Unduŋ tubune Pita adi nemek u mintaguk mebi nadiwit yoŋa ha-nadisulu me Koniliyasdi yapmeune ugiŋ adi wooŋ Saimon yoli kaŋ yeyemeŋ woyakiŋ.
Yaliŋa indiŋ yonadigiŋ, “Me nalum niŋ wou Saimon Pita, adi iŋgoŋ be hatak?”
Nai uŋaniŋ Pita adi nemek lihine dabugoŋ wondiniŋ mebi nadiwe nadinadi kwanai hatuguk. Kaŋ Munabulidi indiŋ niŋguk, “I kalaŋ! Me lufomkulitniŋ adi du golohitabiiŋ,
ale tiulidoko tiŋa fooŋ yabune uuŋdok yoneŋ, kaŋ kibida mu tibeŋ. Mewoi u nagoŋ yenimbe buŋit.”
Unduŋ nimbune Pita adi fooŋ yabuŋa yeniŋguk, “Hidi me lohitabiiŋ nu iŋakoŋ ale maŋgoŋde buŋit? U kedem nanineŋ.”

Unduŋ yenimbune adibo niŋgiŋ, “Mikme’walaŋ talitimeŋ Koniliyasdi ninimbune bumun. Adi me momooŋ, Bepaŋ niutumbalak, eŋ Judame hekidi nadimimbu loloŋnit tubu momooŋ timiiŋ. Bepaŋ’walaŋ aŋelo uŋgoniŋdi indiŋ niŋguk, du ganimbune adi yolineŋ wooŋ mede yobune nadidok niŋguk doktiŋa niniŋkulune bumun.”
Unduŋ niŋgiŋ kaŋ Pitadibo yahaŋeeŋ yopmaŋ yapmeeŋ uŋgoŋ deikiŋ, ala heleune tiulidoko tiŋa noŋgoŋ ugiŋ, kaŋ me Yopahi noli nadisukilitihinit noŋgoŋ yehikeleeŋ ugiŋ.
Ugiŋ kaŋ heleune Sisaliya uŋoŋ Koniliyas adi wapmihiŋiŋ-tam tiŋa meŋimeŋiye eŋ me noliŋiye yehibopneeŋ woom halu wosuwagiŋ.
Wosuwaaŋ Pita yot maaneŋ fowe tubune Koniliyas adi mulelem timiŋguk.
Kaŋ Pitadi honeeŋ tubupilalu yalu niŋguk, “Nu maaŋ me iŋgoŋ, ale unduŋ mu tinambeŋ.”
Mede niŋila niŋila yot maaneŋ fooŋ kalu metam fee bopneeŋ hakiŋ.
Yabuŋa yeniŋguk, “Hidi agaŋ nadiiŋ, Judame adi me Bepaŋ’walaŋ feknit mokit adigut menot titiŋdok moŋ yoiŋ. Iŋgoŋ nu Bepaŋdi nemek undiniŋ u mu keleŋ titiŋdok naniŋak.
Unduŋ doktiŋa hidi nutok mede kamenamuŋit kaŋ lakata mu tiŋat. Ale haninadiwit, hidi maŋgoŋde nutok mede kamenamuŋit?”
Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ Koniliyasdi yoguk, “Helebufa lufolufom agaŋ ulak, wendok maaneŋ heleniŋ 3 kilok tebele Bepaŋ ha-ninadiluwene me niŋ tinahukut fafau hinek tiŋa buŋa namandatne foloŋ yali yoguk,
‘Bepaŋ adi medege agaŋ nadiŋa fiyewakahidok momooŋ tiyemilaŋ wendok welemomooŋ nadilak.
Ale nebek neeŋ yeniŋkulune Yopade wooŋ me niŋ Saimon wou noli Pita adi wou yolineŋ nalum buŋa hatak wooŋ nagila buneeŋ. Wou adi imeŋgwaŋ gagayeŋ itouŋa kale gitnem kwanai tilak.’
Unduŋ naniŋguk doktiŋa pilap hinek me yapmewe ganagitne ugiŋ. Kaŋ du mede nadiŋa buŋaŋ. Ale indi Bepaŋ iŋgoŋ nibudokoune bopneeŋ ilaŋa Wapumdi mede ganiŋguk u ninimbu nadinim yoŋa woomgamam.”
Pitadi Koniliyas yolineŋ Jesu’walaŋ Mede Momooŋ yohautaguk
Unduŋ nimbune Pitadibo mede tububihila indiŋ yoguk, “O, kobuk agaŋ kadakalelat. Biyagoŋ hinek, Bepaŋ adi metam hogohogok talik kubugoŋ keleeŋ yabudokolak.
Tiŋa metam hogohogok kwetkwet hatiiŋ indigoŋ, nebek niŋdi Bepaŋ niutumbaaŋ titiŋ didimeniŋ tilak adi Bepaŋdi kaune utumba tilak. Uŋoŋ kamehep nemu hatak.
Hidi Bepaŋdi Isilaehidok mede kameune hautaguk u agaŋ nadiiŋ. Mede u indiŋ: Jesu wou foloŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ welekulema mintalak. (Adi kunumkwet diniŋ Molom.)
Tiŋa hidi Jon Imeyout Tububihitdi mede yobune mindaŋkade nemek Galili eŋ Judiya maaneŋ mintaguk u maaŋ agaŋ nadiiŋ.
Hidi Jesu Nasaletniŋ adi Bepaŋdi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli kamemiŋa saŋiniŋ miŋguk u agaŋ nadiiŋ. Bepaŋdi adut hatiguk doktiŋa kwetkwet wooŋ metam momooŋ tiyemiŋa me kadakaniŋ’walaŋ saŋiniŋ gineniŋ yanagikuk.
Indi adi nemenemek Jelusalem eŋ Judiya maaneŋ tugukdok sigiyakadi timiyam. Adi unduŋ tubune koloŋdabek foloŋ ulukumuŋgiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ helebufa lufomkulitniŋ dapmaune Bepaŋdi tubupilalune
me sigiyakadi timindok hogok mintayemiŋa nanaŋe ime noŋgoŋ nagiŋ, u adi indikuyoŋ. Metam noli moŋ. Nihidane tuguk indi hogok.
Indi yadi metam Mede Momooŋ indiŋ yenindidimeeŋ yenihautadok niniŋguk. Jesu adi Bepaŋdi mehinek kaipmuŋ hatiiŋ eŋ kumuŋ tigiŋ adi’walaŋ mede nadinadi tibaak nindapmaguk u yohautadok niniŋguk.
Polofet hogohogok adi indiŋ yohautagiŋ, metam nediyeŋ Jesu nadisukilitimiyaneeŋ adi kadakaniŋhik Jesu wou foloŋ tumolokuyemdok.”
Pita adi mede yayolune Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli adi metam uŋoŋ hakiŋ hogohogok welehik maaneŋ foguk.
Unduŋ tuguk kaŋ Judame nadisukilitihinit Pita dut bugiŋ adi Bepaŋdi Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli Judahi’walaŋ fekhinit mokit kameyembu foune
mede mebimebi gineŋ wou niŋa tilogiŋ yabuŋa boho tigiŋ. Boho tubune Pitadi indiŋ yoguk,
“Metam i agaŋ indi tugumun undugoŋ Uŋgoniŋ Munabuli moŋgokiŋ ale nebek niŋdi Imeyout titiŋdok kamehep mu tiyembek.”
Unduŋ yoŋa yenimbune Jesu Kilisto wou gineŋ Imeyout tigiŋ. Tiŋa Pita adigut uŋgoŋ muniniŋ hatiŋa yapmeeŋ uuŋdok niŋgiŋ.
